feature: Secure sessions and linked identities
evidence: Hashed opaque sessions, CSRF binding, revocation/expiry, fixation rotation and explicit fresh-session identity linking. Matching email never silently links. Forged Sites headers are ignored.
remaining_work: Connect OAuth/OTP verification adapters and session-cookie issuance in AUT-001..004. Production account flow is not live.

feature: Free-account initial credits
evidence: Verified-account starter grant keyed once per account. Thirty parallel application calls and replay leave exactly five credits and one grant on PGlite.
remaining_work: Prove multi-connection concurrent signup/login using the native PostgreSQL suite. Public signup verification is separate auth work.

feature: Durable reservation, settle and release ledger
evidence: Row-locked durable reserve/settle/release service. Overspend, duplicate delivery, cancellation, rejection, timeout and crash-fence fixtures pass on PGlite.
remaining_work: Run native PostgreSQL contention/failure tests, then live provider outcome reconciliation. Unknown acceptance remains held safely.

feature: Distributed rate and concurrency limits
evidence: Database-shared fixed-window limits and renewable concurrency leases. Two service instances enforce shared limits in application-level race tests.
remaining_work: Verify actual separate API/worker processes and native database connections under contention/load. Configure deployment limits and worker monitoring.

feature: PostgreSQL schema, migrations and constraints
evidence: Two forward-only migrations, advisory migration lock, historical checksums, ownership/business-key constraints. Empty database, rerun, changed checksum and prior-release upgrade fixtures pass.
remaining_work: Native PostgreSQL/RDS migration verification is tracked as B01/B02 before release.

feature: Users, identities, sessions and personal workspaces
evidence: Persistent users, verified identities, hashed sessions and one personal workspace per account. Composite tenant keys and two-account negative fixtures pass.
remaining_work: Wire public identity adapters and the existing frontend in AUT-001..004/WRK tasks.

feature: Tool runs, result versions, notes and chats
evidence: Persistent runs, versioned results, optimistic notes, threads/messages. Completed/failed/cancelled runs, notes and chat restore after PGlite restart.
remaining_work: Frontend persistence migration and live chat streaming remain separate work.

feature: Files, revisions, extraction and share records
evidence: Tenant-scoped file/revision/extraction/share tables, text-object lifecycle, retry keys, tombstones and durable delete jobs. Failed writes and ownership fixtures pass.
remaining_work: Implement revision-update/download/share-resolution APIs, S3 adapter and secure multi-format extraction. Verify S3 lifecycle on AWS.

feature: Plans, prices, subscriptions and provider events
evidence: Plans/prices/subscriptions/event inbox plus a trusted verified-event service. Replayed/tampered/stale events and repeated period grants are tested.
remaining_work: Verify native concurrent event processing. Add merchant signature adapter and approved plan-change/proration rules; run payment gates.

feature: Usage reservations and append-only allowance ledger
evidence: Reserved/consumed/granted accounts and immutable ledger. Request races, rollback, once-only settlement/release and ledger reconciliation pass on PGlite.
remaining_work: Run the native multi-connection suite and contention/failure fixtures. PGlite serializes transactions and cannot prove PostgreSQL replica behavior.

feature: Outbox, job retries and dead-letter processing
evidence: Transactional outbox commits with run/hold. Durable leases, retries, bounded backoff, stale-ack fencing and inspectable dead letters pass.
remaining_work: Native concurrent worker contention and production queue operations remain release verification gates B01/B02.

feature: Retention, deletion and account export jobs
evidence: Durable export/deletion/object cleanup jobs. Export ownership, immediate access revocation, content redaction, staging cleanup and retention replay fixtures pass.
remaining_work: Approve retention policy; integrate merchant cancellation, provider deletion and backup expiry before production. Standalone chat retention remains open.

feature: Portable Node API and health/readiness endpoints
evidence: Portable Fastify Node service with real loopback HTTP proof and database/outbox readiness checks. Failure responses omit connection details.
remaining_work: Deploy the portable service after production adapters/gates. Existing Sites preview is not wired to it.

feature: Validated request schemas and safe errors
evidence: Strict JSON schemas, body/context bounds, safe error envelopes and rejection of client role/model/owner injection. Portable CSRF and forged-header tests pass.
remaining_work: Continue full route response schemas in API-003 and staging/browser security checks in SEC-003.

feature: OpenAPI specification and typed web client
evidence: Registered OpenAPI specification and typed browser-safe run client. Actual API error, pagination and idempotency transport fixtures pass.
remaining_work: Replace broad response placeholders with complete schemas, generate all client routes, add SSE contracts and connect the existing frontend.

feature: Idempotent tool dispatch and cancellation
evidence: Workspace-scoped idempotency key plus canonical request hash. Atomic reservation/dispatch outbox, cancellation and conservative uncertain-outcome fencing pass with provider doubles.
remaining_work: Live provider adapters/reconciliation are separate blocked/incomplete AI integration work B03. Uncertain holds require confirmed outcome before resolution.

feature: Metadata-only logs and distributed tracing
evidence: Whitelisted metadata logs and W3C trace propagation across actual API request, job and provider-double failure. Raw source, tokens and provider errors are absent from logs.
remaining_work: CloudWatch/OTel export and production alerting remain AWS observability work.

feature: Scheduled cleanup and reconciliation tasks
evidence: Hourly deduplicated cleanup/reconciliation jobs, lease/retry observability and safely replayable export/deletion handlers. Expired unsent holds release; uncertain sent holds remain.
remaining_work: Production scheduler/worker deployment and alerting remain AWS work B02.

feature: Tenant authorization and anti-IDOR tests
evidence: Two-account route/service fixtures deny guessed/cross-user reads and writes across runs, notes, chats, files, shares, exports and billing views. Composite database ownership keys also reject invalid references.
remaining_work: Repeat negative cases as new routes/adapters are added and on staging before release.

feature: Prompt/context trust boundaries
evidence: Server-built context uses only owned records, fixed trusted roles and bounded attachments. Source remains untrusted JSON data, no tools are exposed, and sessions/secrets are excluded.
remaining_work: Live model quality/adversarial evaluation and streaming/UI integration remain AI/chat release work B03.
